p.src: 1  After the death of Joshua, the children of Israel asked of the LORD, saying, “Who should go up for us first against the Canaanites, to fight against them?”

ja: ねた。「カナン人と戦うため、
en: After the death of Joshua, the children of Israel asked of the LORD, saying, “Who should go up for us first against the Canaanites, to fight against them?”

ja: 1:1 すべて大文字の「主」または「神」はヘブル語のיהוה（ヤハウェ）から来ている。ただし、短い形のיה（ヤハ）から来ていると記されている場合を除く。
en: 1:1 When rendered in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, “LORD” or “GOD” is the translation of God’s Proper Name (Hebrew “יהוה”, usually pronounced Yahweh).

p.src: 2  The LORD said, “Judah shall go up. Behold, I have delivered the land into his hand.”

en: The LORD said, “Judah shall go up. Behold, I have delivered the land into his hand.”

ja: 1:2 「見よ」はヘブル語の「הִנֵּה」に由来し、「見なさい」「注意せよ」「よく見よ」などの意味を持つ。しばしば間投詞として用いられる。
en: 1:2 “Behold”, from “הִנֵּה”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection.

en: 1:7 The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “אֱלֹהִ֑ים” (Elohim).
